question: Should OpenClaw add a model-facing parent-only sub-agent send contract, and should it be a dedicated `sessions_send_parent` tool or a reserved `sessionKey: "parent"` target?
rationale: The change creates a new child-to-parent session authorization edge and model-facing tool semantic, so automation should not choose the permanent API shape or security boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Add Dedicated Parent-Only Contract
options.body: Implement a dedicated tool or trusted parent selector that derives the direct parent from spawn metadata and rejects missing-parent, sibling, ancestor, cross-agent, stale-parent, and automatic-forwarding cases.

options.title: Defer To Completion Handoff
options.body: Keep mid-run child-to-parent sends unsupported and rely on completion handoff plus `sessions_yield` for native orchestration.

options.title: Document Broad Opt-In
options.body: Use existing allowlist and visibility configuration for trusted operators while accepting that it is not a parent-only security boundary.

recommendation.title: Add Dedicated Parent-Only Contract
recommendation.body: Implement a dedicated tool or trusted parent selector that derives the direct parent from spawn metadata and rejects missing-parent, sibling, ancestor, cross-agent, stale-parent, and automatic-forwarding cases.

likelyOwner.reason: The most relevant current blame and session-tool history are in the policy, resolver, send, and visibility surfaces tied to this handle.
